description: Source code for MD5-HMAC cryptographic driver in Linux kernel, implementing hashing, key setting, and hardware interaction functions.

methods.name: md5_hmac_transform
methods.description: Saves input block to context, handles dbn workaround.

methods.name: md5_hmac_setkey
methods.description: Sets MD5 HMAC key, supports keys longer than 64 bytes.

methods.name: md5_hmac_setkey_hw
methods.description: Loads MD5 HMAC key into hardware registers.

methods.name: md5_hmac_final
methods.description: Finalizes MD5 HMAC and outputs result.

methods.name: md5_hmac_final_impl
methods.description: Computes final or intermediate MD5 HMAC value.

methods.name: md5_hmac_init_tfm
methods.description: Initializes pointers in MD5 HMAC context.

methods.name: md5_hmac_exit_tfm
methods.description: Frees pointers in MD5 HMAC context.
